entities.name: DeepSeek
entities.desc: Hangzhou. Backed by High-Flyer Quant + National AI Fund (state-led, May 2026) + Tencent + Hillhouse. Models: DeepSeek-V3, V4. Cost-efficient frontier — disrupted US cost narrative Jan 2025. V4 natively optimized for Huawei Ascend; migrated fully from CUDA to Ascend-native. First external funding at ~$50B valuation (May 2026 — largest China AI raise on record). Engram (May 26): conditional memory module committing static knowledge to system RAM, freeing HBM for dynamic computation. Code Harness team launched (May 2026): benchmarking against Claude Code, Cursor, Codex.

entities.name: Baidu
entities.desc: China's Google. ERNIE Bot (文心一言) flagship LLM. Pivoting to AI-first strategy across search, cloud, and autonomous driving (Apollo). AI Cloud #4 in China with tight ERNIE integration.

entities.name: ByteDance
entities.desc: TikTok/Douyin parent. Doubao (豆包): China's #1 consumer AI app, 600M+ generative AI users (May 2026). Volcengine / Seedance 2.0: premiered 'Hell Grind' at Cannes 2026 — world's first full-length AI-generated feature film (95 min, 15-person team, <$500K budget). Consumer brand: 即梦AI. Among 10 Chinese firms cleared for Nvidia H200 (purchase on hold per Beijing). Massive AI infra investment.

entities.name: Alibaba
entities.desc: Qwen (通义千问) open-source LLM series. Qwen 3.7-Max (May 20, 2026): 35-hour autonomous operation, 1,000+ tool calls, announced at Alibaba Cloud Summit Hangzhou. Positions as 'AI factory' (人工智能工厂) across 5-layer stack (chip→cloud→model→platform→app). RMB 380B ($53B) 3-year AI infra commitment. New enterprise model platform: 百炼 (Bǎiliàn). Qiushi signal (June 2026): directed to redirect subsidy spending to AI/cloud capex.

entities.name: Tencent
entities.desc: Hunyuan (混元) LLM. WeChat ecosystem gives massive distribution advantage. Invests across Chinese AI ecosystem: DeepSeek, Minimax, Moonshot, Enflame. Qiushi June 2026 signal directs platform giants (including Tencent) to end price wars and invest in AI.

entities.name: Zhipu AI
entities.desc: Tsinghua University spinout. GLM-4, CogVideo. Listed HKEX Jan 2026: +300%+ since IPO. Joining Hang Seng Tech Index (恒生科技指数) June 5, 2026 — est. HK$51–92B passive inflows via Stock Connect. NDRC instructed to reduce US LP capital exposure.

entities.name: Moonshot AI
entities.desc: Beijing. Founded 2023 by ex-ByteDance engineers. Kimi K2.6: 1T-param MoE open-weight model, 300-agent swarms, 12-hr autonomous runs, ties GPT-5.5 on SWE-Bench Pro (58.6%), ~80% cheaper per token than US equivalents. $2B raise at $20B valuation (May 2026). NDRC ordered to reject US-origin capital without government clearance (Apr 2026). Considering mainland reincorporation under NDRC tech-tracing rules.

entities.name: StepFun
entities.desc: Beijing. Founded 2023. Frontier multimodal AI lab. Eyeing HK$500M Hong Kong IPO mid-2026. NDRC ordered to reject US-origin capital without government clearance (Apr 2026). Considering mainland reincorporation under NDRC tech-tracing rules — US participation in planned IPO will be restricted.

entities.name: Minimax
entities.desc: Tencent + HongShan backed. Abab series LLMs + Hailuo video generation. Listed HKEX Jan 2026: +300%+ since IPO. Joining Hang Seng Tech Index June 5, 2026 — est. up to HK$47B passive inflows via Stock Connect. NDRC instructed to reduce US LP capital exposure.

entities.name: 01.AI
entities.desc: Founded by Kai-Fu Lee (李开复), AI pioneer and former Google China president. Yi model series open-source. Bridge between Chinese and global AI research.

entities.name: Vast
entities.desc: Beijing. Generative 3D and world-model AI. Tripo Studio (text/image-to-3D): ~10M users, 90K studios and enterprise clients. $200M raised at $1B+ valuation June 2026. Backed by Ince Capital + China Life Insurance (中国人寿) venture fund. NetEase partner (逆水寒/Where Winds Meet). Project Eden (伊甸园计划): announced world model for fully explorable 3D environments — unreleased as of June 2026. Founded by Simon Song (ex-MiniMax co-founder).

entities.name: Unitree Robotics
entities.desc: H1, G1, Go2 humanoid and quadruped robots. Private Series D (~$6B). Customers: BYD, Geely. G1 humanoid deployed at Haneda Airport Japan (JAL trial). China's highest-volume humanoid robot maker.

entities.name: UBTECH
entities.desc: Walker S1 humanoid robot. Deployments at automotive OEMs in Guangdong and Jiangsu. China's first publicly listed pure-play humanoid robot company. Morgan Stanley cited as top-volume humanoid shipper.

entities.name: Fourier Intelligence
entities.desc: GR-1 humanoid robot. Early factory pilot deployments. Notable for bipedal mobility design balancing research and industrial use cases.

entities.name: AgiBot
entities.desc: A2 humanoid robot. Well-funded. Among top-volume Chinese humanoid shipment leaders per Morgan Stanley. Strong backing from major Chinese tech and industrial investors.

entities.name: ROBOTERA
entities.desc: Tsinghua spinout. Pioneered full direct-drive dexterous hand (灵巧手). $200M+ raised May 2026. STAR1 + L7 (full-size biped) + M7 (upper-body). Deploying thousand-unit runs at China Post and SF Group logistics centers Q2 2026.

entities.name: X Square Robot
entities.desc: Shenzhen. $430M+ raised; Series B $276M led by Xiaomi + Sequoia China. Also Alibaba, ByteDance, Meituan. WALL-A VLA model. FIRST consumer home deployment: robot cleaning service on 五八到家 (58.com) from May 2026 — China's first commercial residential embodied AI service.

entities.name: GigaAI
entities.desc: Wuhan. SeeLight S1 (时光 S1): two-armed wheeled household humanoid unveiled May 2026. China's FIRST general-purpose household humanoid using embodied AI for autonomous real-time task planning — no hard-coded routines. Capabilities: cooking, laundry, bed-making. 100 units trialling at Wuhan tech housing. Price target: <¥100K by Jun 2027. MIIT HEIS digital ID enrolled.

entities.name: Guangdong Tianji Intelligent Systems
entities.desc: Guangdong. Manufacturing and supply chain robotic systems. Raised ~¥1B ($138M) in back-to-back Series B and B+ (May 2026), led by Hillhouse Capital (高瓴资本) and Meituan (美团). Meituan participation suggests logistics/last-mile optionality.

entities.name: Matrix Robotics
entities.desc: Shanghai (Zhangjiang). Founded by Allen Zhang (张海兴), ex-Tesla China Design and Research Center. MATRIX-3: 1.7m 65kg full-size humanoid, 3.9 km/h, 15kg dual-arm payload, 27-DOF dexterous hand, 3D-woven safety skin. Core tech: WAVE physical foundation large model. Production: 5,000 units 2026, 100,000 target 2027. Debuted BEYOND Expo Macao May 2026. RaaS (机器人即服务) ecosystem.

entities.name: Manus
entities.desc: Autonomous AI agent startup. Meta acquired for ~$2B (early 2026); Beijing vetoed deal — NDRC technology-tracing framework applied to Singapore-incorporated entity. Co-founders placed under exit ban (出境限制). Exploring ~$1B fundraise to buy back from Meta. Key case study for China's new outbound investment review regime (对外投资审查).

entities.name: Spirit AI
entities.desc: Beijing. Universal AI brain for robots — VLA (Vision-Language-Action) model platform. $435M Series A (incl. extension) in 2026 at $1.5B valuation, led by Chaos Investment + YF Capital. Tier 2 embodied AI wave — institutional-lead-backed software layer for physical robots.

entities.name: Galaxea AI
entities.desc: China-based humanoid robotics company. End-to-end embodied AI systems. Series B extended to $435M total in 2026 at $1.4B valuation, led by Jinding Capital. Part of the 2026 embodied AI unicorn cohort.

entities.name: Robotphoenix
entities.desc: Shanghai. Lightweight industrial robots. First significant Chinese robotics IPO in 2026 — listed HKEX May 18, ~$86M raised. Day 1 gain nearly 80%. Sets IPO precedent for Unitree and other Chinese humanoid makers eyeing Hong Kong listings.

entities.name: Leju Robotics
entities.desc: Kuavo humanoid robot. Research and early industrial focus. Part of China's broader humanoid robot ecosystem building out the supply chain.

entities.name: Huawei (AI Chips)
entities.desc: Primary domestic Nvidia alternative. Ascend 910C: mass shipments May 2026, 600K units targeted, SMIC enhanced 7nm, ~1/3 BF16 throughput of Nvidia B200. Ascend 950: next-gen, DeepSeek V4 natively optimized, triggered $5.6B ByteDance order. $12B chip revenue projected 2026. HBM supply is binding bottleneck. LogicFolding/Tau Scaling Law (May 25, ISCAS): targets 1.4nm-equivalent density by 2031. Beijing instructed firms to defer Nvidia H200 deployment to protect Huawei ecosystem.

entities.name: Cambricon
entities.desc: China's leading publicly-listed AI chip designer alongside Huawei on Beijing's government-approved AI hardware procurement list (Xinchuang extension). Targeting 500K chip deliveries 2026 (3× 2025 output). Constraints: SMIC capacity + HBM supply.

entities.name: Biren Technology
entities.desc: BR100 GPU-class chip for AI training. Anke certified May 2026 — listed on China state AI procurement list for the first time. Private. Competing in premium AI accelerator segment.

entities.name: Enflame
entities.desc: Tencent-backed AI chip startup. T30 chip for AI inference and training. Part of the domestic GPU alternative ecosystem accelerated by US export controls.

entities.name: Moore Threads
entities.desc: MTT S4000 GPU. Strong in gaming + AI inference. Anke certified May 2026 for state AI procurement.

entities.name: Iluvatar CoreX
entities.desc: BI-V150. HPC cluster focus. Anke certified May 2026 for state AI procurement.

entities.name: MetaX
entities.desc: C500 series. Series C-funded AI chip startup. Anke certified May 2026 for state AI procurement.

entities.name: D-Robotics (Horizon Robotics)
entities.desc: Revenue-generating AI chip + software supplier to China's AV sector. RDK S100 computing platform. May 2026: integrated with M-Robots OS 2.0 (OpenHarmony-based) — key hardware partner for China's domestic robotics stack. Also supplying humanoid robot manufacturers.

entities.name: Kaihong Digital Industry
entities.desc: Shenzhen. M-Robots OS 2.0 (May 2026): China's first robot OS built on OpenHarmony (open-source Huawei OS). Enables multi-robot coordination and heterogeneous fleet management. Partners: D-Robotics (compute), Guangzhou Saite (cleaning robots), Creality 3D. Alternative to US-origin ROS2.

entities.name: Hygon
entities.desc: AMD-derived architecture. Dhyana CPUs + DCUs for AI. Anke certified May 2026 for state AI procurement.

entities.name: T-Head Semiconductor
entities.desc: Alibaba's in-house AI chip arm. Zhenwu 810E: 560,000+ units shipped to 400+ external customers across 20 industries, RMB 10B+ annualized revenue. Zhenwu M890 (May 20, 2026): 3× perf vs 810E, agent-optimized (long context, multi-model). Panjiu AL128 server (128 chips/rack). Roadmap: V900 (Q3 2027), J900 (Q3 2028). ICN Switch 1.0: 25.6 Tbps AI cluster network chip. Planning STAR Market IPO.

entities.name: CXMT
entities.desc: China's only domestically owned integrated DRAM producer. Hefei. Q1 2026: revenue ¥50.8B (+719% YoY), net profit ¥24.76B (+1,688% YoY). Seeking ~¥29.5B on STAR Market — listing committee review May 27, 2026. Would be largest chip IPO in China's capital markets history. Driven by global DRAM supercycle + domestic procurement shift. Still on US Entity List.

entities.name: YMTC
entities.desc: China's sole commercially operational 3D NAND flash manufacturer. Wuhan. Xtacking architecture, 200+ layers. On US Entity List since Dec 2022. Filed STAR Market tutoring (CITIC Securities), formal IPO application mid-June 2026. With CXMT forms China's 'dual memory champion' axis.

entities.name: Xpeng Turing AI Chip
entities.desc: Xpeng's proprietary AI chip for autonomous driving. 4 chips per robotaxi = 3,000 TOPS onboard compute. Powers both L4 robotaxi (GX platform) and humanoid robot Iron (铁甲). Named after Alan Turing.

entities.name: AsiaInfo Security
entities.desc: Cybersecurity arm of AsiaInfo (telecoms IT). Launched Agent Trust Framework (ATF) in response to OpenClaw agentic AI vulnerability wave (May 2026). Built on 'agent intent alignment' + 'human-AI co-governance' principles.

entities.name: Tuya Smart
entities.desc: Global IoT + AI cloud platform. AI generates 70% of company code. Deployed 6 security defence layers specifically to manage OpenClaw agentic AI risk. NYSE listed.

entities.name: Alibaba Cloud
entities.desc: #1 cloud in China. Hosts Qwen models. AI Cloud capex reacceleration confirmed in recent earnings. Qiushi June 2026 signal constructive for Alibaba Cloud multiples — directed to invest in AI vs. platform price wars.

entities.name: Huawei Cloud
entities.desc: #2 cloud in China. Strong in government and telco. Pangu model. Huawei's vertical integration (chips → cloud → device) creates differentiated sovereign AI offering.

entities.name: Tencent Cloud
entities.desc: #3 cloud in China. WeChat integration advantage. Hunyuan model on Tencent Cloud. Qiushi directed Tencent (via Meituan/PDD name) to redirect capex from price wars to AI.

entities.name: Baidu AI Cloud
entities.desc: ERNIE-powered cloud platform. Strong in AV data (Apollo). Tight integration with Baidu's search and autonomous driving business.

entities.name: Baidu Apollo
entities.desc: China's largest robotaxi operator. Fully driverless commercial service in 10+ cities including Beijing, Wuhan, Shenzhen. Sixth-generation RT6 vehicle at ~¥250K unit cost. Expanding international partnerships.

entities.name: Xpeng
entities.desc: First Chinese automaker to mass-produce an L4 robotaxi (announced May 18, 2026). Pure-vision, LiDAR-free. 4× in-house Turing AI chips = 3,000 TOPS. End-to-end VLA 2.0 model; <80ms latency; no HD maps. VLA 2.0 shared with humanoid robot Iron (铁甲). Pilot commercial ops H2 2026; fully driverless Q1 2027. Amap (高德地图) first global ecosystem SDK partner.

entities.name: Pony.ai
entities.desc: US-listed. Dual business: robotaxi + autonomous trucking. JV with GAC. One of first Chinese AV companies to achieve US listing.

entities.name: WeRide
entities.desc: Global expansion focus. Robotaxi + autonomous bus operations. Deployments in Abu Dhabi and Singapore. NASDAQ: WRD.

entities.name: Momenta
entities.desc: Data-driven AV. Backed by Toyota and GM — cross-Pacific credibility signal. Flywheel data strategy: more miles → better models → more miles.

entities.name: Huawei Smart Car
entities.desc: Supplies ADS (Advanced Driving System) to OEMs as Tier-1 supplier. Partners: AITO, Luxeed. Huawei's strategy: 'Bosch of China AV' — AI brains without building vehicles.

entities.name: MIIT
entities.desc: Ministry of Industry & Information Technology. Regulates AI, telecoms, semiconductors. Developing national agentic AI security standards in response to OpenClaw wave. Administers HEIS digital identity platform for humanoid robots.

entities.name: CAC
entities.zh: 国家互联网信息办公室
entities.desc: Cyberspace Administration of China. Regulates generative AI, data, online content. Co-issued first AI agent (智能体) regulations jointly with NDRC and MIIT on May 8, 2026.

entities.name: NDRC
entities.zh: 国家发展和改革委员会
entities.desc: National Development & Reform Commission. Sets 5-year plans and industrial policy. Ordered leading AI startups to reduce US LP capital exposure and reject US-origin capital without clearance (2026). Codified technology-tracing approach to outbound investment review — effectively blocked Meta's Manus acquisition.

entities.name: MOST
entities.desc: Ministry of Science & Technology. Funds basic R&D and national AI programs. Key allocator of state research grants for AI, semiconductor, and quantum computing.
